subject: Kickoff: streaming keyword spotting for the wake-word stack (Project Riverbed)
body:
Hi team,

Kicking off the streaming KWS effort. We're tracking this internally as Project Riverbed — that's the codename on the roadmap and in the OKR tooling.

What we're building on: our open-source streaming-aware release solves the exact problem killing our current wake-word latency. Instead of waiting for a whole 1-second window, the streaming wrappers let the model consume 20ms audio chunks incrementally and emit classifications in real time. The clever bit is the dynamic topology — one architecture for training (non-streaming), a different one for inference (streaming), converted by the keras wrappers.

Milestones (Apr 27 - Aug 3):
- May 29: reproduce reference accuracy for two model families in both modes
- Jun 26: streaming conversion validated bit-exact against non-streaming on our internal keyword set
- Jul 24: on-device latency readout on the target DSP-class hardware

Alina — staffing and device-lab needs when you can.

Priya
